rule:activated-grants-haste-other-creatu.definition: An activated ability whose cost includes TAPPING the source grants haste until end of turn to another target creature the controller controls. The tap is axis identity, not a cost detail: it caps the ability at once per turn. The untapped-cost form, which goes arbitrarily wide with mana, is rule:activated-grants-haste-any-creature.
rule:activated-grants-haste-other-creatu.why: D3f -- the axis contradicted itself: its scope field (any-creature) matched Boros Guildmage while its definition (tap, another, you control) matched Paragon. This name and definition now match Paragon exactly.

rule:activated-grants-haste-any-creature.definition: An activated ability paid with mana only -- no tap -- grants haste until end of turn to any target creature, including the source itself and creatures the controller does not control. Repeatable within a turn as long as mana is available; the once-per-turn tapped form is rule:activated-tap-grants-haste-other-creature-you-control.
